name: chatbotx
description: Operate a ChatbotX omnichannel chatbot workspace from your AI agent: contacts, conversations, flows, broadcasts, sequences, pipelines, and analytics.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your ChatbotX workspace to look up contacts and conversations, review flows, broadcasts, sequences, and analytics, and carry out a small set of approved actions such as sending a message, tagging a contact, assigning a conversation, or moving a pipeline item. You sign in with ChatbotX and choose the workspace on the consent screen.
defaultPrompt: Show new contact counts per day for the last 7 days
List unassigned conversations and summarize them
Which broadcasts ran recently and how did they do?

positive.prompt: Show new contact counts per day in my ChatbotX workspace for the last 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analytics_new_contact_counts_per_day for the last 7 days and returns the count for each day from the connected workspace.

positive.prompt: List the unassigned conversations in ChatbotX and summarize what each customer is asking about.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls conversations_list filtered to unassigned conversations, reads recent messages with messages_list, and returns a short summary per conversation.

positive.prompt: Which ChatbotX broadcasts ran recently and how did they perform?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls broadcasts_list to find recent broadcasts, then analytics_broadcast_stats, and reports the stats for each broadcast.

positive.prompt: Find the most recently created contact in ChatbotX and add the tag VIP to them.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the contact id with contacts_list, calls contacts_add_tags_by_name, shows the proposed change when CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED is returned, and only applies it after the user approves.

positive.prompt: Show me the pipelines in my ChatbotX workspace and the items in each stage of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls pipelines_list, then pipelines_list_items for the first pipeline, and lists the items grouped by stage.

negative.description: Generic chatbot copywriting with no workspace data
negative.prompt: Write a friendly welcome message for a coffee shop's Facebook Messenger chatbot.

negative.description: Request about a different CRM product
negative.prompt: Export all my HubSpot contacts to a CSV file.
What is the difference between a rule-based chatbot and an AI chatbot?
